omar_cust: Hey team — since the 2024-11-03 rollout our function invocations are coming back incomplete. The tool name is present but args are truncated or missing. High priority, customer is seeing production errors.

maria_support: sorry to hear that, omar. Can you paste a minimal request + response you saw? cc @sanjay_eng @lee_research :eyes:

omar_cust: here's a sanitized curl we used and the response we got from the API (customer says it used to include full args):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"Find the price of widget X and return as tool call","model":"redwood-lingua-2","conversation":[{"role":"user","content":"Find the price of widget X and return as tool call"}],"functions":[{"name":"price_lookup","description":"return price","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'

Response:
{
  "id": "resp-abc",
  "output": "tool_call",
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "price_lookup",
    "args": "{\"sku\": \"WIDG-123",
    "note": "args truncated"
  }
}

maria_support: ouch. Thanks for the snippet. Two quick asks: 1) can you confirm whether this is only on the dedicated instance or also on hosted? 2) any change to SDK or a proxy in front?

omar_cust: hosted. No proxy/version changes on our side. Happened immediately after your morning deploy window. Customer reported 99.2% of these tool calls missing payloads in last hour.

sanjay_eng: I see a deploy-bot message around the rollout time:

deploy-bot: deployed redwood-runtime@v3.14.2 to hosted-cluster-us-east-1 at 2024-11-03T07:12:03Z :rocket:

lee_research: initial hunch — tool_call args are being serialized by the model output and then truncated by a post-processor expecting JSON. Could be a change in the model variant or new tokenizer handling that introduced an unescaped quote, leading to a cut-off.

maria_support: omar, can you attach a raw conversation log (including model tokens) or at least the top-level response body? We need to see exact bytes. If not allowed, a screenshot of the raw response is fine.

omar_cust: attaching partial raw response (redacted):

{"id":"resp-abc","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":null,"tool_call":{"name":"price_lookup","arguments":"{\"sku\": \"WIDG-123\", \"region\": \"us-east\"}"}}]} , note: for many responses arguments is just "{\"sku\": \"WIDG-123"
 (no closing brace)

sanjay_eng: thanks. I'm going to check runtime logs for the request id and the worker that handled it. Can you provide the request ts?

omar_cust: request ts 2024-11-03T07:11:59Z, request id resp-abc.

sanjay_eng: pulled worker logs — I see the model returned a stream that included: 

<<model stream>>: "tool_call": {"name":"price_lookup","arguments":"{\"sku\": \"WIDG-123\", \"region\": \"us-east\"}"}

Then the runtime's json-slicer component reports a parse error: Unexpected end of input at buffer boundary. Looks like the streaming chunk boundary cut an escape sequence.

lee_research: that matches a bug we recently patched in the json-slicer fallback for trimmed-token streams. On long-enough outputs the fallback would drop a trailing quote if the quoted string crosses a chunk boundary when using the new tokenizer packing. We shipped a "robust mode" toggle in v3.14.2 that unfortunately regressed one path.

maria_support: priority P1. omar, we will roll a hotfix but need a short mitigation for the customer. Two possible quick workarounds: 1) pin to model redwood-lingua-2@2024-10-28 (previous) if you can select model version, or 2) set streaming: false in request to force single-chunk output. Could you test option 2 now?

omar_cust: setting streaming:false reduced occurrences in a quick smoke — now 1/50 truncated vs 1/1. Customer can toggle temporarily.

tim_oncall: I'm going to prepare a rollback of v3.14.2 if hotfix can't land within 2 hours. @sanjay_eng and @lee_research please triage ASAP.

sanjay_eng: team -- root cause: a new tokenizer packing + json-slicer robust-mode interaction that mishandles escaped quotes at chunk boundaries, leading to truncated JSON arguments for function calls. Fix: adjust slice boundary handling and ensure we don't cut inside an escape sequence; add unit and fuzz tests. Working on patch now.

lee_research: also adding a monitoring alert to surface sudden spike in "tool_call.args_truncated" metric and a synthetic test that calls functions with long args that exercise chunk boundaries.

maria_support: omar, I'll follow up with the customer and provide the workaround steps (streaming:false) and ETA for a fix. ETA currently ~90 minutes for patch + canary.

omar_cust: Thanks. Appreciate the quick responses — customer is breathing easier with the temporary toggle. Please share canary results when ready.

sanjay_eng: pushing patch to branch hotfix/slice-escape-2024-11-03, running unit + integration, will deploy to canary in 30m.

deploy-bot: started canary deploy redwood-runtime@v3.14.2-hotfix-1 to hosted-cluster-us-east-1 at 2024-11-03T08:05:12Z

lee_research: early canary logs show no truncation on the synthetic long-arg tests. preparing to scale canary to 10% traffic.

maria_support: omar — will notify when 10% canary is live, then again when full rollout completes.

omar_cust: confirmed after enabling the canary the customer's requests look normal. Thank you all! :raised_hands:

sanjay_eng: leaving notes for postmortem: clearly call out regression introduced by "robust-mode" toggle, add pre-deploy synthetic(s) for function-calling patterns, and add a safe-guard that falls back to full-response assembly if json-slicer signals boundary-escape.

maria_support: closing the ticket once full rollout completes; follow-up PM will draft customer-facing RCA and status page update.

tim_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for now. If we see >0.5% truncation after 2h, we'll rollback.

lee_research: adding the postmortem task to eng/reliability board.

maria_support: thanks team, good triage.
